CASTING CALL: LONDON (KENSINGTON) – RECURRING WEB SITCOM SERIES 

**Project Title:** London Comedy Series
**Format:** Narrative, Scripted 10 to 15-Minute YouTube Episodes
**Production Type:** Independent / Non-Commercial Collaborative Passion Project
**Shooting Schedule:** Batched weekend sessions commencing Mid-September 2026

**Compensation & Perks:**
This is a non-commercial collaborative passion project. Roles are un-salaried, but a **£25 flat-rate travel and expenses stipend** is paid directly on the day of filming to fully cover your London commute. Full on-set catering/refreshments and high-quality, fully-edited digital 4K footage will be provided directly for your professional showreel.

**Key Deadlines:**
* **Self-Tape Audition Deadline:** August 30, 2026
* **In-Person Chemistry Reads (Kensington):** September 15, 2026

**Project Overview:**
Written by a published fiction author, this narrative-driven comedy web series dives deep into the chaotic, funny, and highly relatable realities of modern relationship struggles, dating miscommunications, and urban London living. The production is designed predominantly to reflect, entertain, and resonate with the young Black British community.

We are building a permanent, recurring family/friendship circle across multiple episodes. We are seeking highly expressive London-based performers (**Ages 18–35**, Black / African / Caribbean heritage) who excel at sharp dialogue pacing, intense comedic arguments, physical comedy, and strong facial expressions.

 CHARACTER ROLES (4 FEMALES, 4 MALES)

 FEMALE ROLES:
* ANNIE (Series Lead | 18–35  **| Ethnicity - Black**): *The Grounded Interrogator.* Sharp-witted, highly observant, and possessor of a flawless radar for nonsense. She uses weaponized sarcasm, logic, and deadpan calmness to systematically dismantle her partner's excuses. Exceptional comedic timing required.
* SARAH (Recurring | 18–35  **| All Ethnicities**): *The Audacious Disrupter.* Outspoken, completely confident, and utterly unapologetic about her presence. Her unexpected messages, phone calls, or drop-ins always spark massive friction in the household. High screen energy required.
* BLESSING (Recurring | 18–35  **| All Ethnicities**): *The Loyal Hype-Woman.* Annie’s fiercely protective and highly suspicious best friend. She acts as the ultimate digital detective, uncovering "receipts" and backing Annie up with brutal side-eyes and sharp comedic interruptions.
* TIFE (Recurring | 18–35  **| All Ethnicities**): *The Mischievous Firecracker.* Highly energetic and unpredictable. She thrives on chaos and loves stirring the pot just to see what happens. Outspoken, playful, and filterless, she turns small disagreements into massive explosions.
* **LARISA (Recurring | Female | 22–35 | All Ethnicities):** *The Neutral Truth-Teller.* A close, trusted friend to both Annie and Sam. Mature, level-headed, and a natural voice of reason. When either party comes to her to complain about a relationship struggle, she refuses to take sides. She stays completely neutral, delivers the brutal hard truth to both of them, and guides them to work through their differences. Requires an actress who can balance gentle authority with sharp comedic timing.
* 

 MALE ROLES:
* SAM (Series Lead | 18–35 | **Ethnicity - Black**  ): *The Chaotic Charmer.* Charismatic but chronically guilty of trying to take the easy way out of awkward situations. When caught in a tight spot, his brain short-circuits into over-elaborate gaslighting, frantic physical panic, and rapid-fire speech.
* MARK (Recurring | 18–35 **| All Ethnicities**): *The Accidental Saboteur.* Sam’s closest friend. Laid-back, completely oblivious to social cues, and permanently relaxed. In trying to defend Sam, he casually exposes truths that completely ruin Sam’s cover stories with a relaxed smile.
* BEN (Recurring | 18–35 **| All Ethnicities**): *The Naive Accommodator.* Intensely eager to please everyone and completely non-confrontational. He has a fiercely loyal but utterly non-questioning personality, meaning he will agree with whoever is speaking to avoid awkwardness. Highly manipulated by the group.

**HOW TO APPLY:**
Please send a direct message (DM) specifying which character you'd like to play and we'll DM you the email to send your 60-second smartphone self-tape attached audition script to.
1. Your preferred character role(s)
2. Current Headshot / Spotlight link
3. Your general location in London

LOOKING FOR A CAST FOR MY HORROR FILM “AT THE NIGHTMARES EDGE” 

Here are some of the roles that need to be cast.

Jules Riley- a young adult 17-19 who is strong-willed, stubborn, emotionally guarded, and often the voice of reason in the group.

Deputy Mike Duncan — A deputy 40-50yrs and major father-figure presence in Jules's life

Sheriff Riley — Jules's father. 40-50yrs - A stubborn, skeptical lawman who refuses to accept the supernatural elements surrounding the Howard murders.

Detective Craven — 50 -60yrs - The group's experienced investigator/photographer. He's fascinated by the Howard mystery and becomes something of a mentor within the investigation.

Charles Howard / The Killer — The masked killer at the center of the story. *Age does not matter as face is covered with mask, must be very tall and bulky*

Evelyn Howard — Charles's mother. 30-40 - A tragic figure whose journal Axel and Jules discover beneath the Howard property. *Flashback scenes*

Brett Wildrick — Axel's brother. 18-20 Brett is murdered by the killer near the beginning of the movie, making Axel's pursuit of Charles deeply personal.

Ozzy - 18-20 Brett’s best friend who is a rebellious punk type

Chrissy - 18-20 Brett’s Girlfriend who is the voice of reason of that first group

Young Axel- 12-14 The flashbacks of the main character, young rebellious boy who is still mourning the loss of his parents.

Alice Cross — 17-19 Jules's best friend and one of Charles's victims. Flirtatious and ditzy 

Seth Cunningham — 18-20 Another victim whose death is investigated alongside Alice's. Very cocky and arrogant 

Young Charles *flashbacks* 8-10yrs - a young boy who is subject to a paranormal encounter that changes him forever.

Hello! I am posting to try and get my next film casted! This is my most ambitus film I believe I have been apart of! This story needs A LOT of characters, so I'm hoping for the interest :) . Here is the casting call for all the characters needed, character descriptions below! Dates are not exactly figured out yet, due to how many people will be needed to finish the project. However, our first shooting date will be August 28th! That day will be Derek and whoever is casted as Bailey!

**🎬 CASTING CALL — “Not My Movie” 🎥**
**Written & Directed by **Jordan Jackson

**We’re casting for a anthology short film project filming in Colorado Springs. A connected series of stories about identity, genre, attention, loneliness, chaos, and trying to figure out where you belong.**

**━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━**

**The tone ranges from:**

·         **awkward comedy**

·         **existential conversations**

·         **thriller/horror**

·         **emotional drama**

**━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━**

**🎭 CASTING ROLES**

**⭐ BAILEY — CASTING ASAP**

**Female, 20s**

**Bailey is a relaxed, playful, artistic young woman who is painting alone in the woods when Derek literally runs into her. She quickly becomes one of the more thoughtful characters Derek encounters. She listens to his bizarre explanations and doesn't completely believe him—but she finds the idea interesting.**

**🎥 IMPORTANT:**

**BAILEY'S SCENE WILL BE FILMED FIRST ON AUGUST 28TH.**

**You would not need to be there for the entire production day. Bailey's scene is specifically being scheduled first so we can get her portion completed before moving on to the rest of the film.**

**👦 CHRISTIAN (Lead Supporting)**
**Male, late teens–20s**
**Derek’s best friend. Funny, grounded, sarcastic, but secretly wants to belong too.**

**🌌 LAUREN**
**Female, late teens–20s**
**Quietly philosophical and thoughtful. Wonders about humanity, existence, and whether we matter in the grand scheme of the universe.**

**🌼 CARRIE**
**Female, late teens–20s**
**Lauren’s friend. More practical, funny, and grounded. Balances Lauren’s existential spirals with realism.**

**📚 DOUG**
**Male, 20s–40s**
**A perpetually annoyed guy just trying to read his book in peace while Derek accidentally ruins his day.**

**🚗 JENNY**
**Female, late teens–30s**
**Exhausted, anxious, and vulnerable. Lead role in a suspense/thriller segment involving a terrifying roadside encounter.**

**🔧 THE MAN**
**Male, 20s–40s**
**A charming but deeply unsettling stranger. Calm, polite, and dangerous. Horror/thriller role.**

**🩺 DOCTOR**
**Male or Female, 30s+**
**Deadpan comedic doctor with absurd confidence and detective-level diagnosis skills.**

**💉 NURSE**
**Female or Male, 20s+**
**Confused but earnest nurse caught in increasingly ridiculous medical logic.**

**📋 ANOTHER NURSE**
**Any Gender, 20s+**
**Brief but memorable comedic role.**

**💔 MARY**
**Female, late teens–20s**
**Strong-willed and emotionally intelligent. Wants independence in her relationship without constantly being “protected.”**

**🏃 BOBBY**
**Male, late teens–20s**
**Athletic, emotional, and protective. Means well but struggles to understand Mary’s perspective.**

**🎬 CAMERA MAN**
**Male or Female, any age**
**Aggressive, overworked indie film crew member trying to protect “the master shot” .**

**📢 DIRECTOR**
**Male or Female, any age**
**Short but memorable meta-comedy role. Treats Derek like a background extra.**

**SCHOOL EXTRAS**
**All genders, 18+ preferred**
**Students, audience members, background actors, crowds, etc.**

**━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━**

**📍 FILMING LOCATION:**
**Colorado Springs, Colorado**

**💵 COMPENSATION:**
**Unpaid**

**Includes:**
**🎥 IMDb Credit**
**📂 Copy of footage**
**🎭 Experience on an ambitious indie anthology project**

**━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━**

**📩 TO AUDITION / APPLY:**
**Email: ****[jjacks24@uccs.edu](mailto:jjacks24@uccs.edu)**

**Include:**
**• Name**
**• Age**
**• Recent photo/selfie**
**• Availability**

The Film Program at Cinematic Arts at CCA (formerly The Colorado Film School) invites actors of all ages to participate in our Fall 2026 Open Auditions!

Our student filmmakers are casting for a wide range of short films, narrative projects, and cinematic productions, and we are seeking performers of all backgrounds, ages, and experience levels to help bring these stories to life on screen.

Whether you are a seasoned professional, a student, or someone who simply loves acting, you are warmly invited to audition and collaborate with the next generation of filmmakers.

📅 Audition Dates & Times

Friday, September 4, 2026

🕙 10:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.

Saturday, September 5, 2026

🕙 10:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m.

 

📍 Location

Lowry Studios – Community College of Aurora

9075 E. Lowry Blvd.

Denver, CO 80230

 

🎭 What to Prepare

Please bring a 2–3 minute prepared monologue for your primary audition.

In addition to the main audition, we will also host Satellite Auditions for specific student film productions:

• These will take place in rooms throughout the building

• Auditions are first-come, first-served

• Actors can sign up to cold read for individual projects

• We anticipate up to 10 productions casting during this event

• A list of roles and productions will be available on the day of the audition

• Participation in satellite auditions is optional, but highly encouraged

 

📝 How to Sign Up

Actors can sign up using the QR code on the flyer or by visiting:

Accessible Web Link:

https://www.ccaurora.edu/open-auditions

(For visually impaired users or anyone unable to scan the QR code, this link provides full access to the sign-up form.)

If you can't find a reserved space that works for you, come anyway during your preferred time. We will work you into the schedule!

We can't wait to see you this Friday or Saturday!

 

📩 Questions?

Please contact:

galina.boulgakova@ccaurora.edu

 🎥 Help our students tell their stories through the magic of cinema.

Please share this opportunity with your talent networks, acting studios, schools, and community groups — we can’t do this without you!

 

Warmly,

Cinematic Arts Team

Hi Everyone – the August 2026 issue of TheWorkbook’s CENTER STAGE is now on the virtual newsstand.  This month the topic is CREATORS.  In our industry everyone is a creator (actors, writers, casting, directors and producers). 

 

Inside this issue, we speak to Alan Mruvka, founder of E!, on building a platform where creators own their audience instead of pitching for permission. 

 

From the Hollywood campus where creators and producers keep finding each other, to Canada's first Vertical Film Festival opening doors for emerging filmmakers, this issue is about a business with fewer gates and far more ways in, with the reminder that the craft still decides how far you go.

 

You can read the August issue Here, Now! Please click below/

 

[https://publications.castingworkbook.com/center-stage-august-2026](https://publications.castingworkbook.com/center-stage-august-2026)

KEEP GOING. YOUR STORY ISN’T FINISHED YET.

There will be auditions you don’t get.

Self-tapes you work incredibly hard on and never hear another word about.

Roles you were convinced were right for you that ultimately go to somebody else.

That’s the reality of this industry.

But rejection isn’t the end of your story.

Somewhere there’s a role you haven’t read for yet.

A production you haven’t discovered.

A casting director who hasn’t met you.

A character that might fit you in a way nothing before it ever has.

So keep training.
Keep learning.
Keep creating.
Keep auditioning.
Keep showing up.

You cannot control every decision made in a casting room.

But you can make sure you’re still there when the right opportunity arrives.

Your next audition might be another no.

Or it might be the one that changes everything.

Don’t stop before you find out.

CastingCalls.UK
Get Seen. Get Cast.

🎬 VOLUNTEER CASTING CALL | FEMALE ACTRESSES 18–25
I’m looking for female actresses aged 18–25 to volunteer for an upcoming community short-film project.

🎭 Role: Female high-school bullies

📍 Location: Greater Manchester

🎬 Project: Anti-bullying community awareness film

🤝 Volunteer role: Unpaid

The film is being created through a Community Interest Company (CIC) with the aim of raising awareness of bullying and the impact it can have on young people.

The longer-term aim is to make the film available to schools as an awareness tool, helping young people understand the effects of bullying and encouraging conversations around kindness, inclusion, empathy and supporting others.

I’m looking for confident actresses who can portray believable high-school bully characters and are comfortable working as part of a small volunteer cast.

🎭 No professional acting experience is required. If you’re passionate about acting, want to gain experience and would like to be part of a project with a genuine community message, I’d love to hear from you.

📩 Interested? DM me with:

• Your name

• Age

• Location

• A recent photo

• Any acting experience/showreel, if you have one

Please share this post with any actresses who might be interested. ❤️

This is an unpaid volunteer community project created to raise awareness, encourage positive conversations and make a meaningful impact in schools and the wider community. 🎥

CASTING NOTICE: TOO MUCH BASIL

Casting two actors for a 10-minute extract from Too Much Basil, a new play, selected for Flat4 Theatre's Freshly Squeezed Scratch Night at St Margaret's House, East London.

ABOUT THE PIECE

East Village, New York, 1990. Hours after their friend Terry dies of AIDS, Bev and Toni sit up in a kitchen full of boxes, sorting through what's left of him before his family arrives.

Funny, intimate and quietly furious, Too Much Basil explores the often overlooked role of lesbians during the AIDS crisis and the women who cared for, loved and buried a generation of gay men.

ROLES

BEV
Female, 40s. Black. New Yorker.

TONI
Female, 40s. New Yorker. Open ethnicity.

Both actors will need to perform with a convincing New York accent.

CONTENT

The piece contains themes and discussion of AIDS, death, grief and homophobia.

DATES

Tech Rehearsal: Saturday 5 September, 10.00–18.00
Daytime Rehearsal: Thursday 10 September, 10.00–16.00
Performance: Thursday 10 September, 17.00–21.30

VENUE

St Margaret's House
21 Old Ford Road
London E2 9PL

FEE

This is an unpaid scratch performance. Any additional rehearsal will be kept to a minimum and arranged around cast availability.

TO APPLY

Please send a recent headshot, CV or Spotlight/profile link, the role you would like to be considered for, and confirmation of availability for the dates above.

CASTING NOTICE: TOO MUCH BASIL

Casting two actors for a 10-minute extract from Too Much Basil, a new play, selected for Flat4 Theatre's Freshly Squeezed Scratch Night at St Margaret's House, East London.

ABOUT THE PIECE

East Village, New York, 1990. Hours after their friend Terry dies of AIDS, Bev and Toni sit up in a kitchen full of boxes, sorting through what's left of him before his family arrives.

Funny, intimate and quietly furious, Too Much Basil explores the often overlooked role of lesbians during the AIDS crisis and the women who cared for, loved and buried a generation of gay men.

ROLES

BEV
Female, 40s. Black. New Yorker.

TONI
Female, 40s. New Yorker. Open ethnicity.

Both actors will need to perform with a convincing New York accent.

CONTENT

The piece contains themes and discussion of AIDS, death, grief and homophobia.

DATES

Tech Rehearsal: Saturday 5 September, 10.00–18.00
Daytime Rehearsal: Thursday 10 September, 10.00–16.00
Performance: Thursday 10 September, 17.00–21.30

VENUE

St Margaret's House
21 Old Ford Road
London E2 9PL

FEE

This is an unpaid scratch performance. Any additional rehearsal will be kept to a minimum and arranged around cast availability.

TO APPLY

Please send a recent headshot, CV or Spotlight/profile link, the role you would like to be considered for, and confirmation of availability for the dates above.

Casting is inclusive and performers from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply. Where ethnicity is not specified, the role is open to performers of any ethnicity.

* Sandra — Female, 40–59, Hispanic/Latina, Puerto-Rican. Sandra is a perfectionist dedicated to her roles as mother, wife, and chef. She upholds the same high standards in others as she does in herself. *Must be able to speak fluent Spanish (colloquial Puerto Rican).*

There’s no previous acting experience required, but we are just as open to having working actors too.*

**Audition Notice:**

**"Little Shop of Horrors" presented by First Impressions Theatre**

**Audition Dates**:
* Monday September 7th @ 6:30pm 4942 Fraser street at 33rd
* Wednesday September 9th @ 6:30pm 4942 Fraser Street at 33rd
* Monday September 14th @ 6:30pm in Deep Cove 4360 Gallant Avenue

**Production Rehearsal Start Date: **January 2nd 2027

**Submission email:** ad@firstimpressionstheatre.com  **                                                                                                             **

**Performance Dates:**
* Deep Cove February 18th to March 6th (Wednesdays to Saturdays)
* Chilliwack May 8th 
* Coquitlam May 10-15th

**What to prepare for the audition:**

Auditionees will be asked to bring in one 1-2 minute comedic monologue and one song (audition cut please!) of their own choosing ***not from Little Shop*** that they believe **best showcases their abilities**, additionally, please prepare a cutting from below based on role preference. *****Music will be emailed to you when you submit via email*****

                                                                         

**Skid Row Bars 1-21**

**Be A Dentist, bars 42-69**

**Suddenly Seymour bars 32-56**

**                                                                            **

**Contact name:** Claude Giroux

**Submit to:** ad@firstimpressionstheatre.com

**Phone Number:** 604-328-0721

**Company Website:** www.firstimpressionstheatre.com

**Pay: **Non-union, all actors will receive a stipend 

                                          

**FIT** is committed to diversity and we encourage all artists to submit, and to self identify if they so choose. We welcome submissions from artists with a broad range of backgrounds including, but not limited to race, ethnicity, Indigeneity, gender, gender- identification, sexual orientation, class and physical ability. If there are any barriers (language, disability, or any other considerations) preventing you from submitting, please let us know and we will work with you to overcome them.

**Additional Information:** Little Shop of Horrors Music Direction by Jenaya Barker. Choreographed by Alice Battista. Directed by Claude Giroux. 

**Production Description:** The meek floral assistant Seymour Krelborn stumbles across a new breed of plant he names "Audrey II" - after his coworker crush. This foul-mouthed, R&B-singing carnivore promises unending fame and fortune to the down and out Krelborn as long as he keeps feeding it, BLOOD. Over time, though, Seymour discovers Audrey II's out of this world origins and intent towards global domination!

**Roles we are casting:**

**Audrey: **She has poor self-worth and education, but a sweet and vulnerable demeanour. Must be comfortable in high heels. All Genders and ethnicities welcome.

Age: 25 to 35

Vocal range top: D5 Vocal range bottom: G#3 Strong belter musical theatre/pop vocal intuition.

Must be a good mover.

**Orin Scrivello: **An egotistical dentist with a passion for leather and sadistic tendencies. Audrey's abusive boyfriend, who is targeted by Seymour. All genders and ethnicities welcome

Age: 25 to 50

Vocal range top: G4 Vocal range bottom: G2 Strong Vocal presence, Slick, Radio Announcer stylings.

Must be a good mover.

**Crystal, Ronnette and Chiffon:** are street urchins, acting as the occasional Greek Chorus. Young, hip, and smart, these three...maybe four are sassy and seriously street smart. All genders and ethnicities welcome. 

Age: 15 to 35

Vocal range top: F5 Vocal range bottom: Ab3 Strong harmony/blending abilities, 50’s pop sensibility. Strong Belts!

These three do a lot of dancing and doo-wop movement.

**Accessibility:** All rehearsal and performances spaces at FIT are accessible, by ground level access. Accessible washrooms are located in all spaces. Uneven ground may be present in the walkways up to the entrance doors. Our performances spaces are all accessible, though smaller doorways may prove to be an access barrier for some mobility aids.

URGENT CASTING Figuration et silhouettes sur SALEVE( Etrembières, 74100, frontière SUISSE )pour le 02 SEPTEMBRE, H/F entre 25 et 55 ans charismatiques, beaux, très classes, look très BCBG/luxe/milliardaires ou type mannequins , toutes origines.
( priorité aux comédiens/nes, pas de candidature en MP et merci de VRAIMENT lire attentivement l’annonce jusqu’au bout avant de postuler 🙏🏻 )!

Bonjour à toutes et à tous,

Dans le cadre du tournage d’une mini série pour une plate-forme je recherche différents profils en figuration et silhouettes. 

Merci de ne pas postuler si vous ne faites pas de figuration et si vous n’êtes pas disponible le MARDI 02 SEPTEMBRE.
Je ne m’occupe pas du casting figuration pour la petite partie tournée en Suisse. 

Rémunération : cachet 98 euros bruts + éventuelles heures sup/heures de nuit si il y a + majoration silhouette 42,24 si applicable.
Horaires prévisionnels : 09h00/19h00

Je cherche : 
-Des hommes et des femmes très très fortunés type BCBG/très chics/CSP+++/Hyper-luxe/milliardaires/mannequins.
Avec une garde robe très classe/élégante/luxe pour incarner des clients d’un restaurant TRÈS sélect
-pour des silhouettes et de la figuration : des serveurs hommes et femmes très classes hyper luxes ayant impérativement une expérience de service. 

Pour toutes et tous, merci par avance de ne pas postuler si vous ne correspondez pas.

Attention : il est impératif d’être véhiculé/autonome pour se rendre sur le décor. Pas de défraiement prévu : je ne cherche que des gens vivant à proximité( ou acceptant de venir à leurs frais )

Si vous êtes intéressé(e)s, disponibles, que vous correspondez aux critères et que vous N’AVEZ PAS D’IMPÉRATIF HORAIRE sur le jour pour lequel vous postulez, merci de me faire parvenir votre candidature à l’adresse suivante : 

Uas.casting@gmail.com

IMPORTANT merci de préciser en OBJET de votre mail le décor avec la date pour laquelle vous postulez + votre spécificité, votre âge, NOM + Prénom, mensurations :  exemple «  02 SEPTEMBRE RESTAURANT Marc SIMON, 35 ans, 1m80, 78kg mannequin» etc, etc… 

Votre CANDIDATURE doit comprendre IMPÉRATIVEMENT les éléments suivants sinon elle ne sera pas traitée :

-Vos indisponibilités( ou disponibilités )entre le 28 AOÛT et le 03 SEPTEMBRE 

-VOS MENSURATIONS COMPLÈTES( taille, poids, veste, haut, pantalon, chaussures ) 

-Origines ethniques 

-Couleur des yeux

-Couleur des cheveux 

- NOM et Prénom (pas de pseudonyme)

- NUMÉRO DE TÉLÉPHONE 

-Date et lieu de naissance 

-Lieu de résidence( adresse complète )

-2 à 3 photos de vous récentes( dont portrait, en pied et un selfie pris aujourd’hui, sans filtre )

-Préciser si vous avez des expériences de service, des compétences particulières quelles qu’elles soient etc etc 

-Préciser si vous avez des tatouages, des piercings, des cheveux colorés etc.. car nous cherchons régulièrement des gens aux looks atypiques( pas trop sur ce projet mais on ne sait jamais 😉

-Préciser, si vous le souhaitez, si vous avez eu recours à la chirurgie esthétique 

-Préciser si vous avez des tenues très chic/luxe/gala. N’hésitez pas à envoyer des photos de vos tenues si vous le pouvez !

-Préciser si vous disposez de tenues en rapport avec de futurs potentiels décors( serveurs, sportifs, sécu etc … )
N’hésitez pas à joindre des photos de vous en tenues si vous avez.

-Préciser toutes les langues que vous parlez et le niveau et tout accent spécifique que vous pourriez avoir 

-Un CV et une bande démo( si vous avez )pour mon fichier et pour d’éventuelles silhouettes.

-N’hésitez pas à préciser si vous avez des talents particuliers : cascade, sport à haut niveau, musicien, danseur, etc etc 

-Préciser si vous êtes autonomes et par quel moyen( voiture, scooter, vélo, trottinette etc )

-Préciser si vous êtes ok pour faire du co voiturage pour les personnes disposant d’une voiture

-Préciser la marque et la couleur de votre voiture 

-Des photos de votre voiture, scooter, vélo etc pour celles et ceux qui en ont.

Par avance désolée car je ne pourrai malheureusement pas répondre à tout le monde. Je vous re contacterai dès que possible si votre profil correspond. 

Merci par avance à toutes et à tous pour vos futurs envois et belle journée ! 🙂

Anne Arovas, assistée d’Angèle Chenais

Uas.casting@gmail.com

💎DANCE DIAMONDS💎 
Liebe Tänzer, Dozenten und Choreografen,
wir erwarten euch alle zum internationalen Tanzwettbewerb „DANCE DIAMONDS” am 26. und 27. September 2026 in der Stadthalle Kleve.
Registration: www.art-element.de/registration-competition

💎Eingeladen sind Amateure jeden Alters und mit unterschiedlichem Level. Wir bieten folgende Niveau Einteilung an: 
BASIC AMATEURS
ADVANCED AMATEURS
HIGH LEVEL AMATEURS

💎Bühnentanzrichtungen:
Classical Ballet

This is a brilliant opportunity to perform for Kate Bone, an award-winning Casting Associate 

Kate’s impressive portfolio includes work on major productions such as:

  - Star Wars
  - Game of Thrones
  - The Crown

Kate Bone has been Casting Associate with multiple award winning casting directors such as Nina Gold and Robert Sterne for over a decade - operating at the very heart of two of the biggest casting offices in the world.

🎬 **CASTING CALL — FOUR FRIENDS | YORK / LEEDS**

Morning!

I’m looking to cast **a group of four friends**, aged **20–26**, for an** unpaid** lifestyle promo film project, for an ice cream brand due to be filming within the next two weeks (one day).

I’m ideally looking for a group with a **genuine friendship and natural chemistry** though happy to consider those who don't know each other! Personality, energy and authenticity are far more important.

**Location:** York / Leeds area

**Date: **TBC but within the next two week
**Casting:** 4 friends, aged 20–26
**Type of project:** Independent film project
**Payment:** Unpaid
**Expenses & food:** Provided, though only considering York/Leeds talent for this!

The shoot will be a relaxed, collaborative day and a great opportunity to get involved in a creative film project and have some fun along the way.

Please comment below or send me a DM with:
* Your name and playing age
* Where you're based
* Spotlight/Reel/Website

Or feel free to tag anyone who might be a good fit! 

(Pic for attention)

Submission **deadline: August 15, 23:59**

Casting Call- Maggie
Hey everyone! My name is Kalyn Andrea, I’m currently the LP for a proof of concept short filming here in LA. We are having a casting call for one of our supporting characters - MAGGIE

Description: 

MAGGIE 

Woman- 40 to 50 years old; Eastern European, Hispanic, Mediterranean, Mixed Ethnicity, White.

Role involves SFX blood and makeup to be used in scene. *must be comfortable wearing sfx makeup (blood, bruises) 

Details: 

Compensation: Volunteer, non-paid work (we are a self funded budget film sorry!) Credited both in and off screen, as well as IMBD. Meals will be provided. Networking opportunities, we have an amazing crew ready to work on this film! ☺️

Shoot dates: Sept 5,6.

Film location: TBD but scope is within the San Fernando Valley and San Gabriel Valley. 

If you’re interested, please PM your headshot, your height, and your link/reel/resume. Once you’ve PM, please comment so we know you’ve reached out! Also, please share to anyone you think may be interested!! 🎞️

Thank you guys so much for your time and consideration, we hope you audition! Thanks 🙂‍↔️

Mira Tzenov: Wie weit geht sie für ihre Schauspielkarriere? Karrideo TV - Dein Karriere Video 

Mira Tzenov will als Schauspielerin vor die Kamera. Im Interview in Köln erzählt sie von spontanen Castings, ihren Wunschrollen und davon, wie weit sie für ihre Schauspielkarriere gehen würde. 
 
Was passiert, wenn aus dem Traum von der großen Leinwand plötzlich eine echte Chance wird? 
 
Karrideo - Dein Karrierevideo trifft Schauspiel-Newcomerin Mira Tzenov im Rheinauhafen Köln. Direkt am Sommerkino sprechen wir darüber, wie es sich für sie anfühlen würde, eines Tages den eigenen Namen im Vor- oder Abspann eines Kinofilms zu entdecken. 
 
Dabei zeigt Mira Tzenov, wie viel Spontaneität eine Schauspielkarriere verlangen kann. Sonntagabend gegen 21 Uhr kam die Nachricht, dass sie eine weitere Casting-Runde erreicht hatte. Die Frage: Kann sie am nächsten Morgen um 10 Uhr in München sein? Ihre Antwort war klar. Um 4 Uhr morgens ging es von Köln Richtung München. 
 
Im Interview verrät Mira außerdem, welche Rollen sie besonders reizen. Gerade Figuren, die einen starken Kontrast zu ihrer eigenen Persönlichkeit bilden, findet sie spannend. Eine fiese Freundin, eine Diva oder eine Rolle in einer Komödie kann sie sich gut vorstellen. 

Christian Weiße begleitet das Interview als Interviewer, Moderator und Produzent für Karrideo - Dein Karrierevideo.

VOR DER KAMERA BUCHBAR. HINTER DER KAMERA ERFAHREN.

Dieses Foto steht für einen Teil meiner Arbeit, den ich aktuell gezielt weiter ausbaue: Christian Weiße als Schauspieler und Darsteller für Film, Fernsehen, Werbung und digitale Produktionen.

Die Aufnahme entstand im Zusammenhang mit meinem Einsatz für die Sat.1-Produktion NOTRUF. In der Folge „Junger Mopedfahrer crasht in Pkw“ spiele ich den Autofahrer, der unmittelbar am Unfallgeschehen beteiligt ist. Eine Rolle, bei der nicht große Gesten zählen, sondern glaubwürdige Reaktionen, Timing und präzises Zusammenspiel mit Kamera und Regie.

Genau dafür möchte ich mich auch initiativ für neue Produktionen empfehlen.

Ich bringe inzwischen Erfahrung aus zahlreichen Film-, TV- und Streamingproduktionen mit, darunter Alles was zählt, Unter Uns, SOKO Köln, ZDF heute-show, Tatort, Die Füchsin, Identitti, About us / Afterglow und NOTRUF.

VOR DER KAMERA BUCHBAR. HINTER DER KAMERA ERFAHREN.

Dieses Foto steht für einen Teil meiner Arbeit, den ich aktuell gezielt weiter ausbaue: Christian Weiße als Schauspieler und Darsteller für Film, Fernsehen, Werbung und digitale Produktionen.

Die Aufnahme entstand im Zusammenhang mit meinem Einsatz für die Sat.1-Produktion NOTRUF. In der Folge „Junger Mopedfahrer crasht in Pkw“ spiele ich den Autofahrer, der unmittelbar am Unfallgeschehen beteiligt ist. Eine Rolle, bei der nicht große Gesten zählen, sondern glaubwürdige Reaktionen, Timing und präzises Zusammenspiel mit Kamera und Regie.

Genau dafür möchte ich mich auch initiativ für neue Produktionen empfehlen.

Ich bringe inzwischen Erfahrung aus zahlreichen Film-, TV- und Streamingproduktionen mit, darunter Alles was zählt, Unter Uns, SOKO Köln, ZDF heute-show, Tatort, Die Füchsin, Identitti, About us / Afterglow und NOTRUF.

Was mich zusätzlich auszeichnet: Ich kenne Filmproduktion aus beiden Perspektiven. Seit über 17 Jahren realisiere ich selbst Film-, Video- und Contentproduktionen. Dadurch verstehe ich nicht nur meine Rolle, sondern auch Kameraachsen, Anschlüsse, Timing, Bildwirkung, Regieanforderungen und die Abläufe eines Drehtags. topComments.text: Lieber Christian, ich würde Dir raten eine klare, eigene Internetpräsenz zu erstellen und dort UNBEDINGT Videos von Deinen bisherigen Projekten hochzuladen. Und auch hier: Weniger ist mehr!  Es ist immer die "Qual der Wahl" WAS man nun in´s Demo setzt, aber Caster lesen sich nicht A4 Seiten lange Texte durch oder suchen Ewigkeiten nach Filmmaterial. Kurze Takes mit möglichst vielseitigen Spielstilen / Figuren. In Deinem Fall kommt noch hinzu, dass es viele Kollegen mit gleichem Namen gibt - was zusätzlich für Irritation / Verwechslung sorgen könnte. Toi Toi Toi !!! für Deine Ambitionen! :-)

CASTING CALL – PAID ROLE

Feature Film | Chicago Suburbs

We are casting for the role of LUKE, a 10-year-old Black boy for an upcoming feature film.

Character: Luke
Age: 10 years old
Look: We are specifically looking for a very large/chubby child who is 10 but has the physical appearance of an older boy, around 13–14 years old.
Voice: A strong, big voice would be a plus.
Role: Speaking role with multiple scenes.

📅 Production begins: September 10, 2026
🎥 Luke’s filming date: September 25, 2026
📍 Location: Chicago suburbs
💰 Paid role

To Apply:
Please email kentwoodcinemas@gmail.com with:
• Child’s name and age
• Recent photos
• A short video/self-tape introducing themselves
• Parent/guardian contact information
• Location

Parents/guardians only, please submit applications.

We’re looking for a fun, confident young actor who can bring personality and energy to the character of Luke!

GOT AN AGENT BUT NOT GETTING THE AUDITIONS YOU WANT?
This is one of the MOST COMMON problems actors come to me with.

They thought that getting an agent would mean opportunities auditioning for roles in TV and film, and yet the ONLY auditions their agents send them are for commercials.

So some actors think, I’ll leave my agent and find a better one.

And if they do, they often find themselves back with the exact same problem.

But here’s what most actors don’t realise: the solution is NOT what they think.

AND ONCE ACTORS REALISE WHAT IT IS, THEIR ENTIRE CAREER CAN CHANGE.

If you want to know the solution to this problem so you can get the auditions you want:

1. Comment AGENT below and
2. Send me a direct message with the word AGENT.

CASTING CALL – Children – Non-Speaking Product Video - Paid

I'm casting for a non-speaking product video featuring creative building toys similar to LEGO-style construction sets. Non-union.

I'm looking for the following roles:

Role 1 - Female, Age 7-12, Black ethnicity

Role 2 - Male, Age 5-8, Black ethnicity

Ideal Candidates
* Outgoing, confident personalities who enjoy playing with toys
* Able to follow simple direction and stay engaged during filming
* Comfortable in front of the camera
* Previous modeling or acting experience is welcome, but not required
* Siblings or friends would be preferred but not required.

Project Details
* Non-speaking role
* Small-scale, two-person production team in a relaxed, low-stress environment
* The two children will likely be needed for 1–2 hours, though filming may extend up to 4 hours

Pay: $50 CAD/hour (3-hour minimum guaranteed) — Minimum booking of $150 per child

A fun opportunity to earn some extra money, gain on-camera experience, and try something new during summer break!

Filming Schedule

Dates: TBD (sometime in within the next two weeks)

Location: Lower Mainland, BC (exact location TBD, likely surrey or White Rock)

I'm currently building my talent roster and will work around everyone's availability when scheduling filming.

Usage

The finished videos will be published digitally across the client's Amazon listings, website,brand store, social media channels, and other online advertising platforms.

Important Note

Per my client's request and for confidentiality purposes, the finished videos cannot be released to the talent or used for personal portfolios or demo reels.

Parent/Guardian Requirement

A parent or legal guardian must remain on set for the duration of filming for all child participants.

Interested?

Please email the following to runestonepics@gmail.com :
* Child's name, age, and gender
* A few recent photos (phone photos are perfectly fine)
* General availability over the summer
* Any previous modeling or acting experience (optional)

Subject Line: Child Casting Role # – (Age, Gender)

Example: Child Casting Role #1 – 10, Female

Selected applicants will be contacted with additional project details, filming dates, and a model release form.

I look forward to hearing from you

**Schauspieler / Kleindarsteller aus Hamburg sucht neue Projekte**

Hallo,

mein Name ist **Nicolay Bein**, ich bin **41 Jahre alt**, **1,94 m groß** und komme aus **Hamburg**.

Ich suche Einsätze als **Schauspieler, Kleindarsteller oder Komparse** für Film-, Fernseh-, Serien-, Werbe-, Musikvideo- oder Imagefilmproduktionen.

Ich konnte bereits **erste Erfahrungen als Komparse bei einem Filmdreh sammeln**. Diese Erfahrung hat meinen Wunsch, als Schauspieler vor der Kamera zu arbeiten, noch weiter bestärkt. Ich bin motiviert, zuverlässig, pünktlich und arbeite gerne im Team.

Durch meine Größe und mein markantes Erscheinungsbild eigne ich mich unter anderem für Rollen als Sicherheitsmitarbeiter, Polizist, Handwerker, Geschäftsmann, Türsteher oder andere charakterstarke Figuren.

Die Bezahlung richtet sich nach der jeweiligen Produktion und Rolle. Ich freue mich über faire und seriöse Angebote und bin sowohl für einzelne Drehtage als auch für längerfristige Projekte offen.

Anfragen aus **Hamburg** und dem gesamten Bundesgebiet sind herzlich willkommen.

Ich freue mich auf Ihre Nachricht und sende Ihnen auf Wunsch gerne aktuelle Fotos sowie weitere Informationen.

**Viele Grüße**

Nicolay Bein

items.text:
Flashback Friday 🎬

Back to my first feature film, Nacht der Gaukler, directed by Michael Steiner and Pascal Walder — and my first big appearance on the cinema screen.

This film opened doors I could never have imagined and eventually led to encounters with extraordinary people like Catherine Deneuve and Udo Kier.

Back then, the NZZ called me “the Swiss Alain Delon.”

Watching this scene today, I’m thinking… more like the Swiss Tom Cruise. 😂

Apparently, all I did was RUN.

And yes — I did my own stunts. 😎

Fantastic music by Adrian Frutiger.

—

actor • film • theatre
🫶🏻 Stay safe & positive

#FlashbackFriday #tomcruise #SwissCinema #ActorsLife #michaelsteiner

items.summary:
Flashback Friday 🎬

Back to my first feature film, Nacht der Gaukler, directed by Michael Steiner and Pascal Walder — and my first big appearance on the cinema screen.

This film opened doors I could never have imagined and eventually led to encounters with extraordinary people like Catherine Deneuve and Udo Kier.

Back then, the NZZ called me “the Swiss Alain Delon.”

Watching this scene today, I’m thinking… more like the Swiss Tom Cruise. 😂

Apparently, all I did was RUN.

And yes — I did my own stunts. 😎

Fantastic music by Adrian Frutiger.

—

actor • film • theatre
🫶🏻 Stay safe & positive

#FlashbackFriday #tomcruise #SwissCinema #ActorsLife #michaelsteiner

items.text:
**Karrideo TV Stories: Steven Cornelius - der Mensch hinter dem Instagram-Profil** 

Man sieht Posts, Reels, Stories, Reichweite und Follower. Aber wer ist eigentlich der Mensch dahinter? 

In dieser Ausgabe von **Karrideo TV Stories** trifft Christian Weiße seinen Gast Steven Cornelius in Köln. Es wird kein klassisches Social-Media-Tutorial, sondern ein persönliches Gespräch über Stevens Weg, seine Motivation und darüber, was es heute bedeutet, sich als Creator öffentlich zu zeigen. 

Wie fühlt es sich an, wenn aus privaten Gedanken plötzlich Content wird? Wie viel von einem selbst möchte man preisgeben? Und wie schafft man es, auf Instagram sichtbar zu werden, ohne sich dabei zu verbiegen? 

Steven erzählt, wie er seinen Instagram Kanal aufgebaut hat, wie er seine Inhalte plant und warum Persönlichkeit für ihn mindestens genauso wichtig ist wie Strategie. 

Im Gespräch geht es unter anderem darum: 

* wie Steven Cornelius überhaupt zum Content Creator wurde
* was ihn antreibt, regelmäßig Inhalte zu veröffentlichen
* wie viel Planung tatsächlich hinter seinem Instagram-Auftritt steckt
* warum Authentizität leichter gesagt als gelebt ist
* wie er mit Sichtbarkeit, Erwartungen und Wiedererkennung umgeht
* was er Menschen rät, die selbst mit Social Media starten möchten 

**Karrideo TV Stories** stellt dabei nicht nur Accounts, Reichweiten oder Karrieren vor. Christian Weiße möchte den Menschen hinter dem öffentlichen Profil kennenlernen. 

Genau deshalb geht es in diesem Gespräch nicht nur um Instagram, sondern auch um Persönlichkeit, Entscheidungen, Motivation und den Mut, sich sichtbar zu machen. 

Abonniere Karrideo TV und begleite Christian Weiße bei weiteren Gesprächen mit Menschen, deren Geschichten mehr erzählen als ihr Profil. 

**Welche Seite eines Content Creators interessiert Dich mehr: der Erfolg nach außen oder die Geschichte dahinter?**

**Karrideo TV Stories: Steven Cornelius - der Mensch hinter dem Instagram-Profil** 

Man sieht Posts, Reels, Stories, Reichweite und Follower. Aber wer ist eigentlich der Mensch dahinter? 

In dieser Ausgabe von **Karrideo TV Stories** trifft Christian Weiße seinen Gast Steven Cornelius in Köln. Es wird kein klassisches Social-Media-Tutorial, sondern ein persönliches Gespräch über Stevens Weg, seine Motivation und darüber, was es heute bedeutet, sich als Creator öffentlich zu zeigen. 

Wie fühlt es sich an, wenn aus privaten Gedanken plötzlich Content wird? Wie viel von einem selbst möchte man preisgeben? Und wie schafft man es, auf Instagram sichtbar zu werden, ohne sich dabei zu verbiegen? 

Steven erzählt, wie er seinen Instagram Kanal aufgebaut hat, wie er seine Inhalte plant und warum Persönlichkeit für ihn mindestens genauso wichtig ist wie Strategie. 

Im Gespräch geht es unter anderem darum: 

* wie Steven Cornelius überhaupt zum Content Creator wurde
* was ihn antreibt, regelmäßig Inhalte zu veröffentlichen
* wie viel Planung tatsächlich hinter seinem Instagram-Auftritt steckt
* warum Authentizität leichter gesagt als gelebt ist
* wie er mit Sichtbarkeit, Erwartungen und Wiedererkennung umgeht
* was er Menschen rät, die selbst mit Social Media starten möchten 

**Karrideo TV Stories** stellt dabei nicht nur Accounts, Reichweiten oder Karrieren vor. Christian Weiße möchte den Menschen hinter dem öffentlichen Profil kennenlernen. 

Genau deshalb geht es in diesem Gespräch nicht nur um Instagram, sondern auch um Persönlichkeit, Entscheidungen, Motivation und den Mut, sich sichtbar zu machen. 

Abonniere Karrideo TV und begleite Christian Weiße bei weiteren Gesprächen mit Menschen, deren Geschichten mehr erzählen als ihr Profil. 

**Welche Seite eines Content Creators interessiert Dich mehr: der Erfolg nach außen oder die Geschichte dahinter?** 

### ZUSCHAUERFRAGE: Wenn Du Steven Cornelius eine persönliche Frage stellen könntest, die nichts mit Followerzahlen zu tun hat: Was würdest Du von ihm wissen wollen?

# 🗣️ **SCRIPT ANALYSIS ADVICE: **Visualizing the Script 

**"I see myself as a storyteller. So, when I read something, I see the story, and I see it on screen, in my head, in a certain way. I always want to see it and see me in it."** *~ Samuel L. Jackson*

It is for this reason that an actor must read SLOWLY & VISUALIZE everything they are reading. 

Reading this way also allows you to see/feel if the story, the script, moves you emotionally.

Anthony Hopkins reads his scripts 150 times, out-loud...Soooo much more I want to share with you...

Come work with me! - Sandra 💙🎭

Casting Call- Henchman
Hey everyone! My name is Kalyn Andrea, I’m currently the LP for a proof of concept short filming here in LA. We are having a casting call for one of our background characters - HENCHMAN #1 and #2 

Description: 

HENCHMAN 

Tall, 25-25, security guard vibe; Eastern European, Hispanic, Mediterranean, Mixed Ethnicity, White.

*Requires the use of a non-firing replica gun. Armorer provided. 

**Role involves SFX blood and makeup to be used in scene. *must be comfortable wearing sfx makeup (blood) 

Details: 

Compensation: Volunteer, non-paid work (we are a self funded budget film sorry!) Credited both in and off screen, as well as IMBD. Meals will be provided. Networking opportunities, we have an amazing crew ready to work on this film! ☺️

Shoot dates: Sept 5,6.

Film location: TBD but scope is within the San Fernando Valley and San Gabriel Valley. 

If you’re interested, please PM your headshot, your height, and your link/reel/resume. Once you’ve PM, please comment so we know you’ve reached out! Also, please share to anyone you think may be interested!! 🎞️

Thank you guys so much for your time and consideration, we hope you audition! Thanks 🙂‍↔️

URGENT CASTING SUD Figuration et silhouettes H/F entre 16 ans révolus et 70 ans charismatiques, beaux, très classes, sportifs, look très BCBG/luxe/milliardaires ou type mannequins, toutes origines, dont ANGLOPHONES natifs pr 1 date entre le 04 et le 09 SEPTEMBRE sur CASSIS( 13 )
( priorité aux comédiens/nes, pas de candidature en MP et merci de VRAIMENT lire attentivement l’annonce jusqu’au bout avant de postuler 🙏🏻 )!

Bonjour à toutes et à tous,

Dans le cadre du tournage d’une mini série pour une plate-forme je recherche différents profils en figuration et silhouettes. 

Merci de ne pas postuler si vous ne faites pas de figuration, d’indiquer impérativement vos disponibilités/indisponibilités entre le 04 et le 11 SEPTEMBRE.

Pour tous : il est impératif d’être autonomes pour se rendre sur le décor( et en repartir ).
Pas de défraiement transport de prévu, je cherche des personnes vivant à proximité de Cassis( ou souhaitant venir à leurs frais ).

IMPORTANT : l’action est censée se dérouler en 2005, PAS de bouches TROP siliconnées, pas de sourcils carrés et très dessinés et pas de faux ongles très longs.
Pas de tatouages trop récents.
Tribaux ok.

Rémunération : cachet 98 euros bruts + éventuelles heures sup/heures de nuit si il y a + majoration silhouette 42,24 si applicable.
 
Pour le VENDREDI 04 SEPTEMBRE : 
-Des jeunes entre 16 ans révolus et 30 ans( âge apparent )pour incarner des teuffeurs branchés dans une soirée electro hype censée se dérouler à St Tropez début des années 2000.
Piercings, looks arty, atypiques, bobo, mannequins, cheveux décolorés/colorés bienvenus.
Horaires prévisionnels : 13h00/23h00

Pour le LUNDI 07 SEPTEMBRE : 
-Des jeunes entre 16 ans révolus et 30 ans( âge apparent )pour incarner des jeunes très branchés, très fortunés, clients d’un hotel restaurant/club/bar de plage huppé à St Tropez début des années 2000.
Merci de me préciser si vous êtes ok pour vous baigner dans la piscine.
Pour toutes et tous, profils hyper luxe, sportifs, mannequins, hype, jeunesse dorée bienvenus.
-Des personnes ANGLOPHONES( pour les sons seuls ou en cas de passage en silhouette parlante )natives, H/F entre 17 et 35 ans pour incarner des touristes anglais ou américains ivres en train de faire la fête.
-Des H et des F entre 20 et 45 ans pour incarner des serveurs d’un restaurant très chic. Avoir une expérience de service impérativement.
Merci de préciser si vous possédez votre propre tenue.
-Des H barraqués au physique patibulaire pour incarner des hommes de main/vigiles. 
-Des H/F très classes, entre 35 et 70 ans( âge apparent )pour incarner des clients très riches d’un restaurant/bar de plage très sélect à St Tropez.
Horaires prévisionnels : 14h00/00h00

-Pour le MARDI 08 SEPTEMBRE:
Quelques H et F très classes pour incarner quelques passants censés être sur le port de St Tropez.

Pour le MERCREDI 09 SEPTEMBRE 
-Des H et F entre 55 et 75 ans( âge apparent )pour incarner des invités d’une soirée très sélect. 
Profils clinquants, fortune ostentatoire bienvenus. 
-Un homme entre 25 et 45 ans pour incarner un policier en tenue.
Horaires prévisionnels : 13h00/22h00 

Pour tous les profils hype, il faut impérativement avoir des tenues TRÈS classes, arty, luxe à proposer.

Il n’y a pas d’autres dates prévues dans le SUD merci donc de ne pas postuler si vous n’êtes pas disponibles sur cette période. 

Pour toutes et tous, merci par avance de ne pas postuler si vous ne correspondez pas et DE NE PAS POSTULER plusieurs fois si vous êtes disponibles pour plusieurs décors. 

Si vous êtes intéressé(e)s, disponibles, que vous correspondez aux critères et que vous N’AVEZ PAS D’IMPÉRATIF HORAIRE sur le ou les jours pour lesquels vous postulez, merci de me faire parvenir votre candidature à l’adresse suivante : 

Uas.casting@gmail.com

IMPORTANT merci de préciser en OBJET de votre mail le décor avec la date pour laquelle vous postulez + votre spécificité, votre âge, NOM + Prénom, mensurations :  exemple «  SOIREE ELECTRO 04 SEPTEMBRE Kévin FRAIS, 25 ans, 1m80, 78kg Cheveux bleus » ou « CLIENTS RESTAU 07 SEPTEMBRE, Martin BRILLON,40 ans, 1m80, 70kg, Métis » etc, etc… 

Votre CANDIDATURE doit comprendre IMPÉRATIVEMENT les éléments suivants sinon elle ne sera pas traitée :
-Vos indisponibilités( ou disponibilités )entre le 04 et le 11 SEPTEMBRE 
-VOS MENSURATIONS COMPLÈTES( taille, poids, veste, haut, pantalon, chaussures ) 
-Origines ethniques 
-Couleur des yeux
-Couleur des cheveux 
- NOM et Prénom (pas de pseudonyme)
- NUMÉRO DE TÉLÉPHONE 
-Date et lieu de naissance 
-Lieu de résidence( adresse complète )
-2 à 3 photos de vous récentes( dont portrait, en pied et un selfie pris aujourd’hui, sans filtre )
-Préciser si vous avez des expériences de service, des compétences particulières quelles qu’elles soient( ex policier par exemple etc etc )
-Préciser si vous avez des tatouages, des piercings, des cheveux colorés etc.. 
-Préciser, si vous le souhaitez, si vous avez eu recours à la chirurgie esthétique 
-Préciser si vous avez des tenues très chic/luxe/gala. N’hésitez pas à envoyer des photos de vos tenues si vous le pouvez !
-Préciser si vous disposez de tenues en rapport avec de futurs potentiels décors( serveurs, sécu etc … )
N’hésitez pas à joindre des photos de vous en tenues si vous avez.
-Préciser toutes les langues que vous parlez et le niveau et tout accent spécifique que vous pourriez avoir 
-Un CV et une bande démo( si vous avez )pour mon fichier et pour d’éventuelles silhouettes.
-N’hésitez pas à préciser si vous avez des talents particuliers : cascade, sport à haut niveau, musicien, danseur, etc etc 
-Préciser si vous êtes autonomes et par quel moyen( voiture, scooter, vélo, trottinette etc )
-Préciser si vous êtes ok pour faire du co voiturage pour les personnes disposant d’une voiture
-Préciser la marque et la couleur de votre voiture 
-Des photos de votre voiture, scooter, vélo etc pour celles et ceux qui en ont.

Par avance désolée car je ne pourrai malheureusement pas répondre à tout le monde. Je vous re contacterai dès que possible si votre profil correspond. 

Merci par avance à toutes et à tous pour vos futurs envois et belle journée ! 🙂

Anne Arovas, assistée d’Angèle Chenais
Uas.casting@gmail.com

Role Requirements
 Age Requirement: 18+ (due to the nature of the story)
 Female Lead: Age 18–40
 Male Lead: Age 18–40
 Extras: 4 positions available (Male and Female)
Compensation & Value Exchange
This is a micro-budget proof-of-concept production. Payment is provided via a complete professional media package, including:
 Headshot and portfolio update
 Custom-styled showreel footage tailored to your career goals
Location & Contact
 Based in: Toowoomba City, QLD
 Creative Director & Photographer: Casey Miners
 Phone: 0432 282 150
 Email: caseyminers@yahoo.com.au
If you love acting and crave opportunity, please send a direct message or call to get involved and help define the future of RUSTED.

items.text:
We are looking for 3 actors for a rock/indie music video. It’s for an up and coming band and it is low budget so we can only pay for travel to set and food for the day but you can use the footage for your portfolio and will be credited. 

We are looking for the main actors to have a strong screen presence, have a unique, stand-out look, someone you would notice in a crowd of people and be drawn to. Must be comfortable with improvisation and must have availability end of August / early September. We are looking to shoot 1 or 2 weekends, but we will try to be flexible and make it work for all those involved. 

A little bit more about the characters:
Character 1 - woman in her 20’s, stuck in a bad relationship but throughout the video she leaves him, and finds freedom.
Character 2 - man in his 20’s, stuck in a bad job, throughout the video he leaves and finds a better job. 
Character 3 - character 1’s bf - man in 20’s, only will be in one or two scenes, just overall a bad boyfriend. 
Character 4 - character 2’s boss, very animated and snaps at character 2. 

If you think you would be a good fit, please send a short self tape, maybe a short monologue or improvisation piece, no longer than 25-30 seconds through to mirabellasarnyai@yahoo.com , with the title “Music Video Self tape” and include who you are auditioning for in the email. 
We will be accepting self tapes until 22nd August. 

We look forward to hearing from you!

Kellogg’s TV Advert – Open Casting

Real sports teams, clubs & communities needed – London / M25

We’re looking to connect with sports clubs, teams and active communities within the M25 whose members include men aged 50–65.

We’re particularly interested in real people who discovered a love of sport, fitness or movement later in life, especially those with a genuine story behind what got them started.

Activities could include:

Football

Rowing

Swimming

Cycling

Padel

Paddleboarding

Martial arts

Running

Climbing

Team sports

And everything in between

You do not need to be an athlete. We’re looking for everyday people who have found something they love and a community they enjoy doing it with.

items.text:
Jada Pinkett Smith = American actress, producer, musician, and talk show host.
 Multi-talented performer known for 90s films, _The Matrix_, and candid conversations on _Red Table Talk_.

*Quick highlights:*
- *Acting*: 
    - Early TV: _A Different World_
    - Films: _Set It Off_, _The Nutty Professor_, _Scream 2_, _Ali_ as Nia Long’s character’s rival
    - *Niobe* in _The Matrix Reloaded_ & _Revolutions_
    - Voice of Gloria the hippo in _Madagascar_ movies
- *Music*: Fronted the metal band Wicked Wisdom
- *Red Table Talk*: Facebook Watch talk show with her mom Adrienne and daughter Willow. Known for raw, open discussions about marriage, mental health, family
- *Family*: Married to Will Smith since 1997. Mom to Jaden and Willow Smith

She’s been in the spotlight for 30+ years and is known for being outspoken about relationships, Hollywood, and Black women’s health.

Hey Leute, für unser aktuelles Low Budget, Fantasy - Horror Spielfilm Großprojekt (Kinoformat), (die Dreharbeiten sind im vollen Gange, und zu 95% abgedreht) suchen wir noch Darsteller für kleinere Rollen, aber auch Komparsen, für Ritter, Räuber. Ihr habt Zeit und Lust dabei zu sein, dann schickt uns eure Bewerbung mit 2-3 aktuellen Bildern von euch, sowie eure Körpergröße, Kleidergröße, Schuhgröße an: harlekin-filme@web.de oder direkt per Messenger an Harlekin Filme  Gedreht wird im Bayerischen Wald.

Viele Grüße, euer Harlekin Filme Team

Für einen Trailer im Stil von Quentin Tarantino suchen wir eine junge Schauspielerin im Spielalter von ca. 20 bis 29 Jahren.

Rollenprofil:
Du spielst eine Kassiererin, die zunächst unscheinbar und unschuldig wirkt. Gesucht wird ein zierlicher, sehr natürlicher Typ, gerne mit dem Look eines sympathischen „Mädchens vom Land“. Kein auffälliges Make up, keine glamouröse Erscheinung. Natürlichkeit ist uns wichtig.

Die Rolle beinhaltet Dialog und endet in einer inszenierten Erschießungsszene. Die entsprechenden Effekte werden selbstverständlich filmisch umgesetzt.

Drehort: Nordhorn
Drehzeitraum: voraussichtlich Ende August 2026
Drehumfang: 2 Drehtage
Gage: No Budget, keine Gage
Fahrt und Übernachtungskosten: können leider nicht übernommen werden
Verpflegung: Für Verpflegung am Set wird selbstverständlich gesorgt.

Daher suchen wir bevorzugt Schauspielerinnen aus Nordhorn und Umgebung.

Der Trailer ist Teil eines eigenständigen Filmprojekts und soll einen markanten, schwarzhumorigen Action und Crime Stil bekommen.

Bei Interesse schick uns bitte eine kurze Vorstellung sowie aktuelle Fotos und, falls vorhanden, einen Link zu deinem Showreel oder Schauspielprofil an:

📧 a.artur@gmx.net

Wir freuen uns auf eure Bewerbungen! 🎬

🎉**NOUVEAU TOURNAGE - EIFELTOD **🎉

Bonjour à toutes et tous,

Nous sommes de retour sur un nouveau tournage, la série de téléfilms belgo-allemande*** EIFELTOD*** !
En 2 x 90 min, nous serons plongés dans une enquête criminelle révélant progressivement une tragédie familiale. Nous explorerons toute la Province de Liège et la Région germanophone pendant les mois de septembre et d'octobre.

Nous sommes à la recherche de nombreux figurants :

 **ENFANTS, HOMMES et FEMMES dès 8 ans**
pour jouer des élèves, des policiers, des clients d'un bar, des cavaliers dans une écurie, des policiers scientifiques...

**TOURNAGE DU 02/09 au 26/10**
**LIEGE et alentours**
**65 € par jour en IAA**
____

PREMIERES RECHERCHES :

MERCREDI 2 SEPTEMBRE à CHAUDFONTAINE
2 policiers scientifiques entre 25 et 60 ans, bonne condition physique

JEUDI 3 SEPTEMBRE + VENDREDI 4 SEPTEMBRE à STOUMONT
2 personnes de plus de 65 ans

LUNDI 7 SEPTEMBRE + MERCREDI 9 SEPTEMBRE à JALHAY
6 hommes et femmes policiers entre 25 et 60 ans

JEUDI 10 SEPTEMBRE à EUPEN
23 clients d'un bar, barman et policiers dès 18 ans

VENDREDI 11 SEPTEMBRE à ESNEUX
4 enfants entre 7 et 11 ans fêtant Halloween
____

D'autres annonces suivront mais vous êtes invités à déjà postuler pour toutes les dates en septembre et octobre !

Si vous êtes disponibles et intéressés, ne tardez pas à nous envoyer un mail à l'adresse **blanche.castpro@gmail.com avec l'objet "EIFELTOD" et vos DISPONIBILITÉS du 02/09 au 26/10.**

Si nous n'avons jamais travaillé ensemble, merci d'envoyer également : NOM, PRÉNOM, DATE DE NAISSANCE, NUMÉRO DE TÉLÉPHONE, VILLE DE RÉSIDENCE et 2-3 PHOTOS.

Un grand merci d'avance et au plaisir de vous (re)voir nombreux dans cette atmosphère !

Maxime Burton

Blanche Amphiarus-Deprée

IMPACT FEST 2026

September 25–27 | Warsaw, Poland

Three days of stand-up comedy, improv, theatre, music, workshops and live experiences in the heart of Warsaw.

Impact Fest brings together artists and audiences from different countries to perform, learn, collaborate and discover new ideas. Whether you're coming to watch, perform or meet new people, there's something waiting for you.

Headliners

Radu Isac 🇷🇴

Known as "a comedian's comedian," Radu Isac is one of Romania's most respected stand-up comics. Based in London, his style is dark, intelligent and quietly devastating.

His work has been featured on Comedy Central, BBC Radio 4 and the BBC World Service, and he regularly performs across Europe.

Valeria Vulpe 🇲🇩

Originally from Moldova, Valeria Vulpe combines deadpan storytelling with sharp writing inspired by immigration, identity and everyday life.

Winner of Spirit of Comedy 2025 and finalist in So You Think You're Funny?, she also opened for Ricky Gervais at Wembley Arena.

Festival Programme

• International stand-up comedy
• Improv theatre
• Theatre performances
• Live music
• Workshops and masterclasses
• Networking events
• Cultural exchange
• Outdoor performances
• Special guests and surprise events

Last Year

• 400+ attendees
• 25+ performances
• Multiple venues across Warsaw
• Artists from around the world

This year we're welcoming even more performers, workshops and venues across the city.

If you enjoy comedy, performing arts or meeting people from different cultures, we'd love to see you there.

See you in Warsaw this September.

📅 September 25–27, 2026
📍 Warsaw, Poland

🎟 Tickets
https://fienta.com/pl/o/27119

🌐 Website
https://impactwarsaw.com

📷 Instagram
@impactwarsaw
@miguelatcomedy

💬 Inner Circle

**Film-Casting für Kinder in Wien! **🎬🌟

Du bist zwischen 8 und 10 Jahre alt und hast Lust, vor der Kamera zu stehen? Für einen Kurzfilm (Dreh: Herbst/Winter 2026 in Wien) sucht die Filmgruppe „Morgenlicht“ mindestens zwei Hauptdarsteller:innen sowie mehrere Kinder für eine Schulklasse.
* **Wo?** Volksschule Lange Gasse 36, 1080 Wien
* **Wann?** Freitag, 14.08.2026
* **Wer?** Mädchen und Buben von 8–10 Jahren aus Wien
* **Wichtig:** Teilnahme nur mit Voranmeldung!

Da wir allen Kindern ein entspanntes und stressfreies Casting bieten möchten, ist die Teilnehmerzahl begrenzt. Wenn alle Plätze voll sind, können wir leider keine Anmeldungen mehr annehmen. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Da wir allen Kindern ein entspanntes und stressfreies Casting bieten möchten, ist die Teilnehmerzahl begrenzt. Wenn alle Plätze voll sind, können wir leider keine Anmeldungen mehr annehmen. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

**BØRNEFAMILIER OG UNGT PAR SØGES TIL REKLAMEFILM FOR STORT TURIST-BUREAU**

Vi søger medvirkende til en mindre kampagne for et stor Dansk Turistbureau.

Optagelse: 2. + 3. september - Halve dage
Honorar: Voksen 3.000 kr. / Barn 1.500 kr.

**Vi søger følgende:**

**En familie**
* Mor
* Far
* Datter (5–14 år)
* Søn (5–14 år)

**Et ungt par**
* Ung kvinde i 20’erne
* Ung mand i 20’erne

Det er ikke et krav, at familien er en ægte familie, eller at parret er et rigtigt par, men det er klart en fordel, hvis relationen føles naturlig.

Contentet vil blive brugt i Turistbureauets content-bibliotek og kan derfor blive anvendt på forskellige platforme og i forskellige sammenhænge over en længere periode.

Der er fuld buyout.

**Locations:**

D. 2. september – Nordhavn
D. 3. september – Dragør

**Ansøgning:**

Send følgende:
• Et par nyere billeder
• Alder på alle medvirkende
• Dit telefonnummer

Skriv til mbbutlercasting@gmail.com med emnet **Turist**.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

CASTING CALL: LONDON (KENSINGTON) – RECURRING WEB SITCOM SERIES 

**Project Title:** London Comedy Series
**Format:** Narrative, Scripted 10 to 15-Minute YouTube Episodes
**Production Type:** Independent / Non-Commercial Collaborative Passion Project
**Shooting Schedule:** Batched weekend sessions commencing Mid-September 2026

**Compensation & Perks:**
This is a non-commercial collaborative passion project. Roles are un-salaried, but a **£25 flat-rate travel and expenses stipend** is paid directly on the day of filming to fully cover your London commute. Full on-set catering/refreshments and high-quality, fully-edited digital 4K footage will be provided directly for your professional showreel.

**Key Deadlines:**
* **Self-Tape Audition Deadline:** August 30, 2026
* **In-Person Chemistry Reads (Kensington):** September 15, 2026

**Project Overview:**
Written by a published fiction author, this narrative-driven comedy web series dives deep into the chaotic, funny, and highly relatable realities of modern relationship struggles, dating miscommunications, and urban London living. The production is designed predominantly to reflect, entertain, and resonate with the young Black British community.

We are building a permanent, recurring family/friendship circle across multiple episodes. We are seeking highly expressive London-based performers (**Ages 18–35**, Black / African / Caribbean heritage) who excel at sharp dialogue pacing, intense comedic arguments, physical comedy, and strong facial expressions.

 CHARACTER ROLES (4 FEMALES, 4 MALES)

 FEMALE ROLES:
* ANNIE (Series Lead | 18–35  **| Ethnicity - Black**): *The Grounded Interrogator.* Sharp-witted, highly observant, and possessor of a flawless radar for nonsense. She uses weaponized sarcasm, logic, and deadpan calmness to systematically dismantle her partner's excuses. Exceptional comedic timing required.
* SARAH (Recurring | 18–35  **| All Ethnicities**): *The Audacious Disrupter.* Outspoken, completely confident, and utterly unapologetic about her presence. Her unexpected messages, phone calls, or drop-ins always spark massive friction in the household. High screen energy required.
* BLESSING (Recurring | 18–35  **| All Ethnicities**): *The Loyal Hype-Woman.* Annie’s fiercely protective and highly suspicious best friend. She acts as the ultimate digital detective, uncovering "receipts" and backing Annie up with brutal side-eyes and sharp comedic interruptions.
* TIFE (Recurring | 18–35  **| All Ethnicities**): *The Mischievous Firecracker.* Highly energetic and unpredictable. She thrives on chaos and loves stirring the pot just to see what happens. Outspoken, playful, and filterless, she turns small disagreements into massive explosions.
* **LARISA (Recurring | Female | 22–35 | All Ethnicities):** *The Neutral Truth-Teller.* A close, trusted friend to both Annie and Sam. Mature, level-headed, and a natural voice of reason. When either party comes to her to complain about a relationship struggle, she refuses to take sides. She stays completely neutral, delivers the brutal hard truth to both of them, and guides them to work through their differences. Requires an actress who can balance gentle authority with sharp comedic timing.
* 

 MALE ROLES:
* SAM (Series Lead | 18–35 | **Ethnicity - Black**  ): *The Chaotic Charmer.* Charismatic but chronically guilty of trying to take the easy way out of awkward situations. When caught in a tight spot, his brain short-circuits into over-elaborate gaslighting, frantic physical panic, and rapid-fire speech.
* MARK (Recurring | 18–35 **| All Ethnicities**): *The Accidental Saboteur.* Sam’s closest friend. Laid-back, completely oblivious to social cues, and permanently relaxed. In trying to defend Sam, he casually exposes truths that completely ruin Sam’s cover stories with a relaxed smile.
* BEN (Recurring | 18–35 **| All Ethnicities**): *The Naive Accommodator.* Intensely eager to please everyone and completely non-confrontational. He has a fiercely loyal but utterly non-questioning personality, meaning he will agree with whoever is speaking to avoid awkwardness. Highly manipulated by the group.

**HOW TO APPLY:**
Please send a direct message (DM) specifying which character you'd like to play and we'll DM you the email to send your 60-second smartphone self-tape attached audition script to.
1. Your preferred character role(s)
2. Current Headshot / Spotlight link
3. Your general location in London

* **LARISA (Recurring | Female | 22–35 | All Ethnicities):** *The Neutral Truth-Teller.* A close, trusted friend to both Annie and Sam. Mature, level-headed, and a natural voice of reason. When either party comes to her to complain about a relationship struggle, she refuses to take sides. She stays completely neutral, delivers the brutal hard truth to both of them, and guides them to work through their differences. Requires an actress who can balance gentle authority with sharp comedic timing.
* 

 MALE ROLES:
* SAM (Series Lead | 18–35 | **Ethnicity - Black**  ): *The Chaotic Charmer.* Charismatic but chronically guilty of trying to take the easy way out of awkward situations. When caught in a tight spot, his brain short-circuits into over-elaborate gaslighting, frantic physical panic, and rapid-fire speech.
* MARK (Recurring | 18–35 **| All Ethnicities**): *The Accidental Saboteur.* Sam’s closest friend. Laid-back, completely oblivious to social cues, and permanently relaxed. In trying to defend Sam, he casually exposes truths that completely ruin Sam’s cover stories with a relaxed smile.
* BEN (Recurring | 18–35 **| All Ethnicities**): *The Naive Accommodator.* Intensely eager to please everyone and completely non-confrontational. He has a fiercely loyal but utterly non-questioning personality, meaning he will agree with whoever is speaking to avoid awkwardness. Highly manipulated by the group.

**HOW TO APPLY:**
Please send a direct message (DM) specifying which character you'd like to play and we'll DM you the email to send your 60-second smartphone self-tape attached audition script to.
1. Your preferred character role(s)
2. Current Headshot / Spotlight link
3. Your general location in London

🎬 CASTING CALL: Afrikaans Actors Needed — Kort Verhale (Short Films)

We are looking for actors who are **fluent in Afrikaans** to star in a series of short films (Kort Verhale) covering different stories — drama, romance, family conflict, and more.

📍 **Filming primarily in Pretoria and Johannesburg**, but actors from other areas are welcome to apply.

**We're looking for:**

- Fluent Afrikaans speakers (all ages, all types welcome)

- Comfortable performing dramatic/emotional scenes on camera

- Available for short shoot days (usually 1 day per short film)

- No professional experience required — passion and presence matter more

**To apply, please send:**

- Your name, age, and area/city

- A short self-tape (1–2 min) of you speaking Afrikaans, or reading a short line naturally

- A recent photo

- Any acting experience (if you have it — not required)

📩 Submit to: superkuruman@gmail.com or WhatsApp: 069 062 0985

THIS IS A PAID GIG!!!

New stories are filmed regularly, so if you're not cast for the first one, we keep a talent list for future roles.

Tag a friend who should apply! 🎥

items.text:
CASTING CALL

As the Sun Sets, Student Short Film 

A coming-of-age drama following a Miami family of 3: a 17-year-old Soleil, her mother Sandra, and her father Cruz. After Soleil is invited to a prestigious dance audition for her dream school, they embark on a journey along the East coast where they are forced to confront their complicated reality as family. 

Filming Location: Tallahassee, FL

All Roles: Unpaid. Travel & accommodation expenses covered. All Meals Provided 

Union/Non-Union, Professional and Non-Professional Actors.

Now Casting:

Supporting
* Sandra — Female, 40–59, Hispanic/Latina, Puerto-Rican. Sandra is a perfectionist dedicated to her roles as mother, wife, and chef. She upholds the same high standards in others as she does in herself. *Must be able to speak fluent Spanish (colloquial Puerto Rican).*
* Cruz — Male, 40–59, Hispanic/Latino, Cuban-American. Cruz is a frustrated workaholic. He's afraid of his age and a victim of his past. He pushes his family away in an attempt to fulfill his dreams, while simultaneously living vicariously through his daughter's. *Must be able to speak intermediate Spanish (ideally colloquial Cuban and Miami dialect) and be comfortable driving while performing.*

(If available) Send Headshot, Resume & Demo Reel to: 

ava22c@fsu.edu

Submission Deadline: August 30th

Shoot Dates: 4 Days • Sept 10th - 13th

*I’m a part Puerto-Rican, part Cuban filmmaker born and raised in Miami, Florida. This story is very near and dear to me and my upbringing plays a huge part. That being said, the cultural authenticity of the film is of utmost importance to me, that’s why I’m looking for real Puerto Ricans and Cubans who really connect with this story to be a part of this project. There’s no previous acting experience required, but we are just as open to having working actors too. Thank you!

items.text:
Casting Call- TEDDY
Hey everyone! My name is Kalyn Andrea, I’m currently the LP for a proof of concept short filming here in LA. We are having a casting call for one of our supporting characters - TEDDY

Description: 

TEDDY 

Man preferably- 40 to 50 years old; Eastern European, Hispanic, Mediterranean, Mixed Ethnicity, White. Must know how to read and speak Russian/ with a Russian Accent. 

Requires the use of a non-firing replica gun. Armorer provided. Role involves falling on the floor after gun shots, stunt coordinator and the stunt crash pads for safety will be present on set. Also, SFX blood will be used in scene (nothing too gory tho) 

Details: 

Compensation: Volunteer, non-paid work (we are a self funded budget film sorry!) Credited both in and off screen, as well as IMBD. Meals will be provided. Networking opportunities, we have an amazing crew ready to work on this film! ☺️

Shoot dates: Sept 5,6. Rehearsals (1-2) to happen during week of Aug 16 and 23, so open/flexible schedule for those two weeks is appreciated!!

Film location: TBD but scope is within the San Fernando Valley and San Gabriel Valley. 

*must be comfortable wearing sfx makeup (blood, possible gs wounds) 

If you’re interested, please PM your headshot, your height, and your link/reel/resume. Once you’ve PM, please comment so we know you’ve reached out! Also, please share to anyone you think may be interested!! 🎞️

Thank you guys so much for your time and consideration, we hope you audition! Thanks 🙂‍↔️
